description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the intelligence layer for an AI-powered recruiting marketplace, including the systems that match candidates with relevant roles. You will own recommendation, ranking, and retrieval capabilities from early design through production.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build recommendation, ranking, and retrieval systems for candidate-role matching.

 - Develop LLM-powered features and improve matching quality using measurable outcomes.

 - Take product features from problem definition to production, shipping at a rapid cadence.

 - Build and maintain the data pipelines and backend services that support production models.

 - Work with company leadership to translate product goals into working systems.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Two to five years of experience building and shipping end-to-end software features in production.

 - Production experience with recommendation systems, ranking algorithms, or ML-powered matching.

 - Experience shipping ML models or ML-powered products to users, with hands-on work in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent frameworks.

 - Proficiency in TypeScript or Python and experience building production features with LLM APIs.

 - Experience maintaining production data pipelines and services, ideally in a fast-moving startup environment.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals; React, embeddings, vector search, Supabase, Prisma, Typesense, or workflow automation tools are helpful.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary is $130,000 to $170,000 annually, plus competitive founding-hire equity. Visa sponsorship is available for eligible candidates.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California. The role works in person six days per week.
